title: Hoshino Ichika — No Answers Tonight〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... Is Shiho here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Ichika? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, thank goodness. You're still here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's nothing serious, but I was hoping to ask you a quick question...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A quick question?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Remember those yakisoba bun flavored snacks you brought over when Saki and I were working on that song at her house?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Can you tell me where you got them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where? This one convenience store by her house... Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They were really good, so I wanted to get some more. I tried looking everywhere, but I couldn't find a store that sells them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. After doing some research, it turns out that they were only available for a limited time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Plus, they apparently flew off the shelves because this one video about “delicious limited edition delectables” went viral a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I didn't realize they were so popular...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Which means it was pretty lucky that I managed to find them when I did.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, I was hoping that the store you went to would still have some in stock...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see.
In that case, I can tell you where you need to go.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's, um... Actually, it's sort of tucked away, so finding it on your own might be tough... Why don't we go together? I've got some time today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'll take me? Thanks, Shiho.
Several dozen minutes later
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Too bad they ran out.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There were a ton when I went, but I guess they really blew up in popularity.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They did. All the yakisoba bun lovers have been talking about how hard it is to find them now...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, are you telling me there's a whole community of yakisoba bun lovers...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah, there is.
I found them through social media.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They talk about companies that make good products, as well as when they change the recipe for the buns and such. All really useful information that pops up in my feed from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: O-Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess I'll keep looking a bit more online... Failing that, I'll just have to wait for them to make more.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Anyway, Shiho, thanks for coming with me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No, that's all good.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Since we're walking part of the way back together, wanna check out a few convenience stores and supermarkets along the way...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As popular as they may be, I've gotta think that some place still has them in stock.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? You don't mind?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm kinda curious now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If they're so popular, then I feel like I should try them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's look for them together...
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I can't believe we found some...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm glad we were able to find a little hole in the wall that still had a bunch in stock.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Me too!
Thank you for helping look for them, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, that's fine. Just let me try one of those in return.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Then, let's head over to that park.
Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you were right. These are good...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right?! I think they did an amazing job of making it taste like there's extra sauce. They even captured the slightly sweet taste of a freshly baked bun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can tell that the people who made this must really love yakisoba buns...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To summarize, I'm really impressed by how they made these. Also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, sorry... I didn't mean to get so worked up...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's okay. I mean, it's a bit late for that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But hearing your glowing review made me want some more. Can I have another one...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, have as many as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here!
